notes: Do not create coreblow/plugins. OpenClaw does not use an openclaw/plugins repository.
Keep bundled plugin source in the core repository until a specific plugin graduates into a product repo.
Satellite repositories are public release surfaces with their own CI, README, CODEOWNERS, and ownership model.
